name: Device Identity and Enrollment
description: Devices have identity. Enrollment binds a device to an account with cryptographic proof. A device identity includes a device key pair, attested hardware or software binding, and a signed enrollment receipt.
purpose: Establish device-level trust so that sessions, capabilities, and revocations are scoped to specific devices.
acceptanceCriteria: Device identity schema defined with device key pair, device type, device name
Enrollment flow: device generates key pair, sends public key to server, server issues signed enrollment certificate
Enrollment receipt produced and stored for audit
Device attestation optional but supported (TPM, Secure Enclave, hardware-bound key)
Enrollment can be revoked — revocation invalidates all device-bound sessions
Device identity is verifiable without server round-trip via signed challenge-response
